name: HDFC Regalia Gold Credit Card
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g1' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%231a237e'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%230d1b2a'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g1)' stroke='%23fbbf24' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23fbbf24'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23ffffff' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>REGALIA GOLD</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%23fbbf24' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>HDFC BANK • VIP</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23e53935' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23fbc02d' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: Premium lifestyle & travel card offering complimentary global airport lounge access and 4X rewards on luxury brands.
description: The HDFC Regalia Gold is an elite travel and dining companion. Get complimentary lounge access across India and overseas, Marks & Spencer / Myntra vouchers on milestone spends, and comprehensive travel insurance.

benefits.title: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.desc: 12 complimentary airport lounge visits annually at domestic and international terminals via Priority Pass.

benefits.title: 4X Reward Points
benefits.desc: Earn 4 reward points on every ₹150 spent, and 20 reward points on select retail and lifestyle partners.

benefits.title: Milestone Privileges
benefits.desc: Quarterly vouchers worth ₹1,500 on spends of ₹1.5 Lakhs every calendar quarter.

benefits.title: Low 2% Forex Markup
benefits.desc: Save heavily on international shopping and overseas hotel bookings with reduced foreign exchange fees.

features: 12 Complimentary Airport Lounge access
Club Vistara Silver tier membership
Low foreign currency markup of 2%
Comprehensive air accidental cover up to ₹1 Crore

name: SBI Cashback Credit Card
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g2' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%23047857'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%23064e3b'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g2)' stroke='%2334d399' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23a7f3d0'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23ffffff' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>CASHBACK 5%</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%2334d399' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>SBI CARD</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%230284c7' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%2338bdf8' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: Direct 5% statement cashback on all online merchant spending with no merchant restrictions.
description: Simply the best pure cashback credit card in India. Earn 5% cashback auto-credited into your monthly statement on Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato, BookMyShow, and all digital platforms.

benefits.title: 5% Online Cashback
benefits.desc: Flat 5% direct statement credit cashback on almost all online spending up to ₹5,000 per billing month.

benefits.title: 1% Offline Cashback
benefits.desc: Earn 1% cashback on in-store retail card swipes, dining, and offline fuel stations with zero capping.

benefits.title: 1% Fuel Surcharge Waiver
benefits.desc: Valid across petrol pumps in India for transactions between ₹500 and ₹3,000.

benefits.title: Annual Fee Reversal
benefits.desc: Spend ₹2,00,000 or more in an anniversary year to get your next year annual renewal fee waived completely.

features: Auto statement credit within next billing cycle
No merchant restrictions on 5% cashback
Contactless NFC payments supported worldwide
Instant add-on card for family members

name: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Card
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g3' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%231e293b'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%230f172a'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g3)' stroke='%23f97316' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23fed7aa'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23f97316' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>AMAZON PAY</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%2394a3b8' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>ICICI BANK • LIFETIME FREE</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23ea580c' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23fbbf24' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: Unconditional lifetime free card with 5% Amazon Prime rewards and zero maintenance costs.
description: The highest rated Lifetime Free card in India. Amazon Prime members earn 5% unlimited reward points directly converted to Amazon Pay balance, with zero joining fees and zero renewal charges forever.

benefits.title: 5% Unlimited Rewards
benefits.desc: Prime members earn 5% cashback on all Amazon India orders with no minimum transaction requirement.

benefits.title: Lifetime Zero Fees
benefits.desc: Never pay a joining fee or annual renewal charge. Completely free card ownership for life.

benefits.title: 2% on Bill Payments
benefits.desc: Earn 2% on mobile recharges, electricity, broadband, and 100+ partner merchants through Amazon Pay.

benefits.title: Culinary Treats Dining
benefits.desc: Minimum 15% discount on dining bills at 2,500+ partnered restaurants across India.

features: 1 reward point = ₹1 Amazon Pay balance
No expiry date on earned reward points
Lifetime zero membership and renewal charges
1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel stations

name: Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g4' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%23831843'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%23500724'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g4)' stroke='%23f472b6' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23fbcfe8'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23ffffff' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>ATLAS MILES</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%23f472b6' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>AXIS BANK • TRAVEL</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23db2777' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23f43f5e' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: The ultimate miles card for frequent flyers: convert EDGE Miles to Singapore Airlines, Qatar, and Marriott.
description: Axis Atlas delivers an unprecedented rewards rate on airline bookings and hotel stays. Earn up to 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 spent and transfer 1:2 to world-class airlines and hotel loyalty programs.

benefits.title: 5,000 Welcome Miles
benefits.desc: Get 5,000 bonus EDGE Miles upon paying the joining fee and initiating your first 30-day swipe.

benefits.title: 5X on Travel Bookings
benefits.desc: Earn 5 EDGE Miles on every ₹100 spent directly on domestic/international flights and hotel bookings.

benefits.title: International Lounge + Guest
benefits.desc: Up to 18 complimentary international lounge visits with guest access based on your Tier status.

benefits.title: 1:2 Airline Transfer
benefits.desc: Transfer points to 20+ airline and hotel partners at the highest conversion ratios in India.

features: Up to 18 international & domestic lounge visits
Complimentary guest access privileges
Direct 1:2 airline miles transfer ratio
Exclusive silver, gold, and platinum tier acceleration
docName: Axis Atlas Card Schedule of Benefits (PDF)

name: AU LIT Credit Card
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g5' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%23581c87'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%233b0764'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g5)' stroke='%23c084fc' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23e9d5ff'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23ffffff' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>LIT CUSTOM</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%23c084fc' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>AU SMALL FINANCE BANK</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%239333ea' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23c084fc' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: India's first customizable credit card: switch perks like lounge access or 5% cashback on and off via app.
description: Why pay for features you do not use? AU LIT allows you to turn on airport lounge visits when traveling, switch to 5% grocery cashback when shopping, and turn off features when resting — paying only when active.

benefits.title: On-Demand Features
benefits.desc: Turn on/off airport lounge access, accelerated reward points, and OTT subs via the mobile app.

benefits.title: 5% Extra Cashback
benefits.desc: Activate 5% cashback on apparel, dining, and grocery purchases for 90-day periods.

benefits.title: Free Lounge Activation
benefits.desc: Activate 4 airport lounge visits per 90 days specifically when you have an upcoming trip.

benefits.title: 1% Fuel Surcharge Waiver
benefits.desc: Continuous 1% fuel surcharge waiver valid across all fuel stations in India.

features: Customizable power: pay only for active perks
No permanent annual fees on the base card
Instant feature toggle via AU 0101 app
Up to 10X reward points on active categories
docName: AU LIT Card User Handbook & Terms (PDF)

name: BPCL SBI Card Octane
imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='190' viewBox='0 0 300 190'><defs><linearGradient id='g6' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%237c2d12'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%23431407'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='300' height='190' rx='14' fill='url(%23g6)' stroke='%23ea580c' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='38' height='26' rx='5' fill='%23ffedd5'/><text x='24' y='135' fill='%23ffffff' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' letter-spacing='1'>OCTANE 7.25%</text><text x='24' y='160' fill='%23fb923c' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' font-weight='bold'>BPCL • SBI CARD</text><circle cx='250' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23c2410c' opacity='0.85'/><circle cx='268' cy='150' r='16' fill='%23ea580c' opacity='0.85'/></svg>
tagline: Save up to 7.25% (25X reward points) on Bharat Petroleum fuel, lubricants, and Bharat Gas bookings.
description: Engineered for vehicle owners and commuters, the BPCL SBI Card Octane offers unbeatable savings on petrol and diesel, combined with 4 domestic airport lounge visits each year.

benefits.title: 7.25% Valueback on Fuel
benefits.desc: Earn 25 reward points per ₹100 spent at BPCL fuel stations + 1% fuel surcharge waiver.

benefits.title: 6,000 Welcome Points
benefits.desc: Receive 6,000 reward points worth ₹1,500 immediately upon paying joining fee.

benefits.title: 4 Airport Lounge Visits
benefits.desc: Complimentary access to domestic airport lounges (1 per calendar quarter).

benefits.title: 10X on Groceries & Dining
benefits.desc: Earn 10 reward points per ₹100 on groceries, departmental stores, and dining.

features: 7.25% effective savings on fuel and gas
4 domestic airport lounge visits per year
Welcome bonus points worth ₹1,500
Annual fee waiver on ₹2 Lakh annual spend
